scenarios_goal.name: Scenarios Goal
scenarios_goal.statement: Full coverage of product-scoped canonical diagnosis capabilities, plus risk-weighted coverage of policy, runtime, host, and platform-specific tails.
scenarios_goal.generation_policy: Versioned agents generate canonicalization, risk scoring, scenarios, fixtures, oracles, qualification evidence, and post-freeze challenge batches; deterministic validators reject incomplete or inconsistent outputs.
scenarios_goal.rule_use_policy: Surveyed tools and their rule catalogs are provenance inputs only; scenarios create Kubernetes faults and validate normalized predicates from native evidence without installing or executing those tools.
scenarios_goal.product_scope: A capability is product-scoped only when Headlamp can obtain its required evidence and present or safely orchestrate its outcome on a declared supported profile.
scenarios_goal.canonical_capability: An agent-reviewed cross-tool equivalence class with the same subject, trigger predicate, required evidence, expected finding, negative condition, and material platform constraints.
scenarios_goal.core_completion: Every approved product-scoped canonical capability has qualified positive and healthy-negative scenarios, plus uncertainty, temporal, or confounder cases when those are part of the predicate.
scenarios_goal.tail_completion: Cover every critical tail capability and at least 80 percent of source-grounded, multi-agent-reviewed risk weight within each of policy, runtime, host, and platform-specific domains.
scenarios_goal.accounting: Report targeted, implemented, and qualified coverage separately; tool-local occurrences and semantic groups are provenance and progress measures, not the completion denominator.

optimization_objective: Maximize distinct remaining direct-predicate semantic groups and improve undercovered source tools using reproducible Kubernetes states after excluding active and v1/v2/v3/v4 targets.

methodology.selection: Select exactly 110 reviewed single-trigger states or coherent bounded action chains from five prioritized undercovered tools.
methodology.deduplication: Reject active coverage, v1/v2/v3/v4 targets and semantic groups, duplicate v5 occurrences or identities, and partial kube-bench profile groups.
methodology.qualification: Keep every specification draft and pending until setup, observation, oracle, and leakage blockers are resolved.
